lune.training.collect.about: Chop Wood finishes, but its drops are still on the ground. Collect them before END.
lune.training.collect.hint: Breaking a block and picking up its drops are separate jobs. Put a collecting card between Chop Wood and END, on both outcomes.
lune.training.collect.title: Drops are not inventory
lune.training.count.about: A clock feeds Loot every time. Make the branch run only on every third pulse.
lune.training.count.hint: Counting signals is different from waiting. Insert the counting card between Pulse and Loot, and set its count to 3.
lune.training.count.title: Every third pulse
lune.training.delay.about: A Button starts Loot immediately. Add a pulse delay before Loot starts.
lune.training.delay.hint: A delay holds a signal for a little time before passing it on. Put it between the Button output and Loot, then connect its Out pin to Loot.
lune.training.delay.title: A pause before collecting
lune.training.fanout.about: One clock, and two separate circuits that both need starting.
lune.training.fanout.hint: The clock has one output and there are two circuits to power. Add the junction card, then use the Outputs button in the toolbar to give it a second output before you wire both branches.
lune.training.fanout.title: One pulse, two jobs
lune.training.guard.about: A chopping loop, and an Always source with nothing hanging off it.
lune.training.guard.hint: Chop Wood chops wood. It does not surface for air, fight back, or flee, and the engine does not do it on the routine's behalf. The Always source is already here and already empty - give it the card that watches air, lava, falls and health.
lune.training.guard.title: Nothing is implicit
lune.training.manual.about: A collecting branch is ready. Give it a source you can trigger yourself.
lune.training.manual.hint: This routine should wait for you, instead of starting on launch or on a clock. Connect the manual source's Out pin to Loot.
lune.training.manual.title: Only when you press
lune.training.scout.about: Loot is ready to return to Chop, but there is an empty gap for a scout.
lune.training.scout.hint: Place Explore after Loot, connect Loot Success and Fail to it, then connect Explore Success and Fail back to Chop. Give Explore a shorter radius than Chop Wood so the scout has a reason to walk.
lune.training.scout.title: The loop that never moves
lune.training.start.about: Two cards, wired to each other, and nothing that switches them on.
lune.training.start.hint: Every routine needs a power source. This one wants a single signal at the top, sent once - not a source that holds the branch on forever, and not one you have to press yourself.
lune.training.start.title: Where a routine begins
lune.training.store.about: Harvest and Loot fill your inventory. Store the collected items before END.
lune.training.store.hint: Loot picks items up. A separate storage card puts them into a nearby chest or barrel. Connect it after Loot and before END, and set Deposit to Crops or All.
lune.training.store.title: Bring the harvest home
lune.training.tool.about: Mine is pointed at stone, and stone is not minable by hand.
lune.training.tool.hint: Nothing on this canvas puts a pickaxe in the bot's hand. Choosing an item it does not own is not the same as getting one. Add the card that acquires the tool, and run it before the Mine card.
lune.training.tool.title: The tool comes first
